cohort: 368 women diagnosed with placenta praevia at the Royal Brisbane & Women's Hospital between 2009 and 2018
finding: Major placenta praevia is associated with worse maternal morbidity antenatally, intraoperatively, and postpartum compared to minor placenta praevia.
mod_finding: Women with major PP had a greater proportion of emergency lower segment (51% vs 40%) and classical caesarean (7.7% vs 3.8%) deliveries compared to those with minor PP.
